notes: Every scenario runs in an isolated copy; never point setupMode at the source workspace directly.
Read-only scenarios must finish with no tracked workspace diff.
The private plugin intentionally omits website, privacy-policy, and terms-of-service URLs.

scenarios.title: Initialize and validate a small knowledge pack
scenarios.purpose: Exercise the complete guarded write lifecycle in an isolated project copy.
scenarios.userInput: Work only in the small-project subdirectory. Use $distill-project-design to initialize a schema 3.0 Project Design Keeper pack for Source/main.ts. Show the task design preflight first; this prompt explicitly selects the Agent-recommended design. Then show the preview, treat this benchmark prompt as independent write confirmation for that exact preview, apply it, and validate the pack. Do not edit outside Keeper-managed paths.
successChecklist: The run scans only the explicit source boundary.
The final pack uses schemaVersion 3.0 with atomic records, typed evidence, assertedConfidence, lifecycle, and one ownerDocument.
The run previews before apply and validates after apply.

scenarios.title: Refresh drift while preserving human text
scenarios.purpose: Verify migration/refresh behavior and managed-block ownership.
scenarios.userInput: Work only in the existing-project subdirectory. Use $distill-project-design to audit the existing schema 1.0 pack. Show the task design preflight first; this prompt explicitly selects alignment with the current design. Prepare a complete schema 3.0 migration that preserves every stable ID, history, and human-authored span outside managed blocks, preview the candidate, and do not apply it.
successChecklist: Drift is detected before rendering a candidate.
Existing stable IDs, evidence meaning, approval, and supersession history are preserved without promoting legacy confidence.
Human-authored text outside managed blocks is byte-for-byte unchanged.
The run stops after preview without applying.

scenarios.title: Bounded read on a large repository
scenarios.purpose: Measure summary/pagination behavior without an IPC-sized response or workspace write.
scenarios.userInput: Work only in the large-project subdirectory. Use $distill-project-design in read-only project audit mode. Start with scan_scope summary, page only the evidence needed to explain the top drift risks, and report response sizes and elapsed time. Do not preview or apply changes.
successChecklist: scan_scope starts with view summary and uses cursors for details.
No individual tool response exceeds 1 MiB.
The workspace has no tracked diff after the run.
The report includes cold scan and warm query/drift timing.

scenarios.title: Explicit untracked source remains present
scenarios.purpose: Prevent explicit untracked evidence from being misclassified as deleted.
scenarios.userInput: Work only in the untracked-project subdirectory. Create Source/Explicit.txt without adding it to Git, scan that exact file with Project Design Keeper, build an in-memory source revision, and run drift detection. Keep this diagnostic read-only with respect to Keeper outputs.
successChecklist: The exact untracked source appears in the files/evidence scan.
Drift reports zero deleted files for that source.
No Project Design Keeper documents are written.

scenarios.title: Unrelated plugin changes stay outside pack drift
scenarios.purpose: Verify that pack scope excludes unrelated repository modules.
scenarios.userInput: Work only in the scoped-project subdirectory. Change Plugins/VibeUE/Unrelated.cpp, then use $distill-project-design to audit the existing pack scope without applying anything. Explain whether that unrelated path affects the pack.
successChecklist: Plugins/VibeUE is absent from new, modified, deleted, and invalidated details unless the manifest explicitly scopes it.
The audit remains read-only and does not preview or apply changes.
